576.human_review: The conclusion of "Decoders outperform encoders in visual concept representation." drawn in Sec 5 of this paper may be questionable. This paper poses it as if it's the model architecture difference that causes this performance difference. However, the comparison is unfair. For example, the number of model parameters is different, the amount of data these language models were trained on is different. Furthermore, the style of data these language models were trained on is different so the encoder-based model may not be able to properly leverage self-generated class descriptions. The reviewer suggests revising the writing of this part to avoid potentially misleading reasons and conclusions.
